prompts.clear: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production equirectangular game sky texture. Generate ONE seamless FULL SPHERE 360 degree longitude by 180 degree latitude panorama in EXACT 2:1 aspect ratio, ideally 2048x1024. It is an UNWRAPPED spherical sky texture, NOT a perspective landscape, NOT a fisheye. Equator/horizon lies EXACTLY halfway down image; upper half is sky above horizon; lower half softly continues atmospheric colors into the nadir with no objects. Left and right edges join seamlessly. Zenith top row and nadir bottom row each converge to uniform color so no pinching or streaks at poles. Clouds must have appropriate equirectangular spherical distortion especially near top, small angular scale, and be spread around whole 360 degrees, not one gigantic closeup cloud. Theme: Tropical cobalt-blue daytime sky, sculptural towering white cumulus clusters with warm sunlit ivory edges and rich blue undersides. Clouds distributed around ALL longitude directions, each cluster SMALL angular size 10-20 degrees, abundant blue open sky overhead; a thin distant cloud bank exactly on equator. Vibrant late-1990s tropical adventure game atmosphere. Style: polished hand-painted detailed stylized sky, natural volumetric cloud anatomy, sharp varied silhouettes, vivid saturation, atmospheric light. NO landscape, water, mountains, buildings, trees, borders, text, labels, panorama frames, collage, watermarks. This image wraps INSIDE a spherical skybox; every portion should work when viewed through a 90-100 degree camera.
